shortcut_name: unbounded battery with free deficit coverage
evidence: All survivors maintain an uncapped `battery` and update it with `battery = 0` when insufficient, then add `p2`; both use the same gain/loss ordering.
affordance_in_statement: The battery starts with 0 units of stored power and has no upper limit on its capacity. ... If the battery currently holds less than p1 units, the battery is completely drained to 0, and the deficit is seamlessly covered by an external power grid.
removal_suggestion: Introduce an input-dependent storage limit, while specifying that generated power exceeding the limit is discarded; this removes the uncapped transition that enables the common ordering shortcut.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Split applications into p2 > p1 and p2 <= p1, sort the first group by increasing p1 and the second by decreasing p2, then simulate an uncapped battery.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The battery ... has no upper limit on its capacity, and deficits are covered by an external power grid.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Split into p2 >= p1 and p2 < p1, sort good applications by increasing p1 and bad applications by decreasing p2, then simulate an uncapped battery.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The battery ... has no upper limit on its capacity, and the deficit is seamlessly covered by an external power grid.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Use the same positive/negative net-change partition and ordering, with an uncapped battery simulation.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The battery ... has no upper limit on its capacity.

common_affordance: The battery state is an uncapped nonnegative reserve: insufficient consumption is truncated at zero and all generated power is retained.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It sorts every application only by p2 - p1 descending, rather than using increasing p1 for net-positive applications and decreasing p2 for net-negative applications.

recommended_edit: Add: "The battery capacity is limited to the maximum p2 among all applications; any generated power beyond that capacity is discarded." This preserves the supplied examples but invalidates the uncapped simulations and their shared ordering shortcut on general inputs.
regression_risk: The edit changes the transition dynamics, so it may make the previously wrong net-change ordering appear correct on some new cases, though it does not generally restore qwen3-coder's algorithm.
